title: Breast Cancer
subtitle: StewardMD ONCOTREE navigator (draft)
provenanceNote: ONCOTREE navigator DRAFT for invasive breast carcinoma. Nodes capture the physician-entered clinical phenotype (histology, stage group, treatment setting/intent, HER2 and hormone-receptor status) and route to APPLICABLE existing StewardMD Standard Protocols by reference. Hormone-receptor status is captured for HER2-positive and HER2-negative disease alike, so hormone-receptor-positive disease surfaces adjuvant endocrine therapy regardless of HER2 status. The navigator invents no dose, no regimen, and no eligibility criterion; treatment options are the existing protocol records, resolved live with their lifecycle badge. Structural taxonomy consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Breast Cancer; no proprietary content is reproduced. DRAFT - not clinically activated; physician decides.
sourceNote: Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Breast Cancer. Treatment options reference existing StewardMD Standard Protocols and their own evidence layers.

nodes.name: Histology
nodes.title: Confirmed histology
nodes.description: Select the confirmed pathology. In-situ disease follows a distinct pathway from invasive carcinoma.

nodes.name: Stage group
nodes.title: TNM stage group
nodes.description: Physician-entered stage group. ONCOTREE does not compute a stage; enter the confirmed clinical/pathologic stage.

nodes.name: Setting and intent
nodes.title: Treatment setting and intent
nodes.description: Select the clinical setting. Neoadjuvant/adjuvant are curative-intent for early/locally-advanced disease; metastatic disease is palliative-intent.

nodes.name: HER2 status
nodes.title: HER2 status
nodes.description: HER2 by IHC (3+ positive) or ISH amplification. HER2 status separates HER2-directed therapy from HER2-negative pathways. Hormone-receptor status is asked next in both cases.

nodes.name: Hormone receptor status
nodes.title: Hormone receptor (ER / PR) status
nodes.description: HR-positive = ER and/or PR positive. In HER2-positive disease, HR status does not change HER2-directed therapy, but HR-positive disease additionally warrants adjuvant endocrine therapy.

nodes.name: Hormone receptor status
nodes.title: Hormone receptor (ER / PR) status
nodes.description: HR-positive = ER and/or PR positive. HR-negative with HER2-negative defines triple-negative breast cancer.

nodes.name: HER2-positive, HR-positive therapy
nodes.title: HER2-positive, HR-positive: applicable protocols
nodes.description: HER2-positive AND hormone-receptor-positive disease. HER2-directed therapy applies (by stage/setting), and HR-positive disease additionally warrants adjuvant endocrine therapy. Physician selects; the existing dose engine computes doses.

nodes.name: HER2-positive, HR-negative therapy
nodes.title: HER2-positive, HR-negative: applicable protocols
nodes.description: HER2-positive, hormone-receptor-negative disease. HER2-directed therapy applies, narrowed by stage and setting. Physician selects; the existing dose engine computes doses.

nodes.name: HR-positive HER2-negative therapy
nodes.title: HR-positive, HER2-negative: applicable protocols
nodes.description: Hormone-receptor-positive, HER2-negative disease. Endocrine therapy is the backbone; CDK4/6-inhibitor-based and cytotoxic options apply by stage/setting. Physician selects.

nodes.name: Triple-negative therapy
nodes.title: Triple-negative (HER2-negative, HR-negative): applicable protocols
nodes.description: Triple-negative breast cancer (ER-negative, PR-negative, HER2-negative). Cytotoxic backbones and, in the neoadjuvant setting, pembrolizumab-chemotherapy apply by stage/setting. Physician selects.

nodes.name: DCIS - ER status
nodes.title: DCIS: estrogen-receptor status
nodes.description: Ductal carcinoma in situ is managed distinctly from invasive disease (local therapy). Risk-reducing endocrine therapy applies only to ER-positive DCIS. The invasive systemic-therapy pathways do not apply.

nodes.name: DCIS management
nodes.title: DCIS: management
nodes.description: ER-positive DCIS: risk-reducing endocrine therapy after local therapy. ER-negative DCIS: local therapy only - no systemic therapy is indicated, so no applicable systemic protocol is expected.
